days.title: Peaks and Lakes of the High Black Forest
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Haus der Natur
stops.detail: The administrative headquarters is the House of Nature in the municipality of Feldberg on the highest mountain in the Black Forest, the 1,493 m high Feldberg.

stops.name: Feldsee
stops.detail: In the Feldsee, there is a species of spiny-spored quillwort that, besides the Feldsee, only occurs in the Titisee and is classified as endangered by the IUCN.

stops.name: Titisee
stops.detail: According to legend, the Titisee and the Ursee are connected to each other underground.

days.title: Highlands and Southern Summits
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schluchsee
stops.detail: With a maximum area of 5.14 km², the Schluchsee is the largest lake in the Black Forest.

stops.name: Herzogenhorn
stops.detail: At the Herzogenhorn there is a network of hiking trails; the nature trail leading to the summit passes by the Krunkelbachhütte.

days.title: Gorges and Waterfalls
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schluchtensteig
stops.detail: Several long-distance hiking trails lead through Blumberg, such as the Schluchtensteig.

stops.name: Triberger Wasserfällen
stops.detail: In addition to the Triberg Waterfalls (the second highest waterfalls in Germany), there are around 50 other waterfalls in the Southern Black Forest.

stops.name: Wutachschlucht
stops.detail: The Wutach Gorge is 60 to 135 meters deep; sights in the gorge include the heritage-protected Stallegg river power plant and the Stallegg fir tree.
